validation.emailInvalid: Enter a valid e-mail address, like name@example.com.
validation.passwordTooWeak: It is too easy to guess. Make it longer or combine several unrelated words.
validation.confirmMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
validation.codeIncomplete: Enter the 6 digits of the code.
validation.recoveryCodeFormat: Recovery codes look like this: XXXXX-XXXXX.

password.hint: At least {min} characters. A phrase of several unrelated words is easy to remember and hard to guess.

crackTime.minutes: It would be guessed in minutes.
crackTime.days: It would hold for a few days.

warnings.common_password: It contains one of the most used passwords.
warnings.common_word: It contains a very common word, name or brand.
warnings.dictionary_word: It is made of ordinary words: add more, or mix them with something else.
warnings.repeated: It repeats characters or groups, like "aaaa" or "abcabc".
warnings.sequence: It contains a sequence, like "abcd" or "4321".
warnings.keyboard_pattern: It follows a keyboard pattern, like "qwerty" or "asdf".
warnings.predictable_shape: It has the most common shape: a word, then digits, then a symbol.

breached.one: This password appears {count} time in known breaches. We recommend choosing another one.
breached.other: This password appears {count} times in known breaches. We recommend choosing another one.

password.breachedHow: We check without sending it: only a fragment of its fingerprint leaves the device.

irrecoverable.title: Nobody can recover your master password
irrecoverable.body: It encrypts your vault on this device and never leaves it: neither AccioPass nor anyone else knows it, so we cannot reset it. If you forget it, the only way back in is the recovery words we will give you next.
irrecoverable.bodyRecovering: It encrypts your vault on this device and never leaves it: neither AccioPass nor anyone else knows it, so we cannot reset it. If you forget it, the only way back in is the one you are using now, your recovery words: they stay the same, so keep them safe.

acceptances.allRequired: Tick all four boxes: each one is required.
acceptances.terms: I accept the Terms and Conditions
acceptances.termsError: To create the account you need to accept the Terms and Conditions.
acceptances.privacyNotice: I have read the Privacy Policy
acceptances.privacyNoticeHint: It tells you which data we process and what for. This is not consent: you only confirm that you have read it.
acceptances.privacyNoticeError: Confirm that you have read the Privacy Policy.
acceptances.ageError: AccioPass can only be used from the age of 16. Tick the box if you are.
acceptances.noRecovery: I understand that nobody, AccioSoft included, can recover my master password
acceptances.noRecoveryHint: If you forget it, the only way back in is your recovery words.
acceptances.noRecoveryError: Confirm that you have understood this before going on.
acceptances.stale: The legal documents have just been updated. Read them again and send the form once more.

biometrics.unlocking: Waiting for your fingerprint or face…
biometrics.offer: You can open your vault on this device with your fingerprint or your face. The master password will still be needed to sign in and for important changes, and you can turn this off in Settings whenever you like.
biometrics.offerHow: The key that opens the vault is kept in the system keystore, which only hands it over after checking your fingerprint or face. If you add another fingerprint or face to the device it is erased by itself, and we will ask for the password again.
biometrics.confirmPassword: Type your master password to turn it on.
biometrics.enabled: Done. Next time you can unlock with your fingerprint or your face.
biometrics.unsupported: This device has no fingerprint or face set up that can be used for this. Add one in the system settings and try again.

deriving.register: Creating your keys on this device. The master password goes through Argon2id, a calculation that is slow on purpose; it can take a few seconds.
deriving.login: Deriving your key on this device with Argon2id. It is slow on purpose: that makes trying passwords far more expensive.
deriving.unlock: Checking your master password on this device…
deriving.recover: Checking your words and encrypting your vault with the new password. It can take a few seconds.

social.simulated: Development simulator: these sign-ins do not use real accounts.
social.note: The provider confirms who you are; your vault still opens only with your master password.
social.offline: Signing in with a provider needs a connection.

welcome.headline: Your passwords and codes, encrypted on your device.
welcome.body: AccioPass keeps your passwords and generates your two-step verification codes. Everything is encrypted with your master password before it leaves your device: not even we can read it.

facts.together: Passwords and codes in one place

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: All you need is an e-mail address and a master password: the only one you will have to remember.
register.offline: Creating an account needs a connection.

verify.title: Check your e-mail
verify.sentTo: We have sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 15 minutes.
verify.resendIn: You can ask for another code in {time}.
verify.resent: We have sent you a new code.
verify.keepOpenTitle: Do not close or reload this page
verify.keepOpen: Your recovery words are shown right after verifying and, until then, they exist only here. If you close or reload before that, we will not be able to show them.
verify.noWordsTitle: You will need to generate your recovery words
verify.noWords: Verification was not completed when the account was created, so we can no longer show you the recovery words. As soon as you are in, generate new ones in Settings > Security > Recovery words.
verify.notArriving: Not arriving? Check your spam folder. If you already had an account with this address you will not receive a code: sign in instead.
verify.offline: Verifying the code needs a connection.

words.title: Save your recovery words
words.intro: These 24 words are the only way to recover your account if you forget the master password. With them and your e-mail your vault can be opened: keep them as you would keep your house key.
words.rotatedIntro: These 24 words replace the ones you had. With them and your e-mail the account can be recovered if you forget the master password.
words.rotatedOldTitle: The previous words no longer work
words.rotatedOld: From this moment only these are valid. Destroy the ones you had kept so you do not mix them up, and save these before going on: AccioPass cannot show them to you again.
words.once: AccioPass does not store these words anywhere. Write them down on paper or save them outside this device before you continue.
words.hidden: The words are hidden. Make sure nobody else can see the screen.
words.copied: Copied. Paste them somewhere safe: the clipboard will clear itself.
words.downloaded: File downloaded. Keep it outside this device and delete it from Downloads.
words.downloadFailed: The file could not be created. Copy the words or write them down by hand.
words.fileWarning: Keep this file somewhere safe and offline. Anyone with these words and access to your e-mail can open your vault. AccioPass cannot show them again.
words.confirmIntro: Type the words at these positions. That way we know you saved them correctly.
words.confirmWrong: That is not word no. {position}. Check what you saved.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter the e-mail of your account and your master password.
login.resume: Your data is still on this device. Sign in to sync again.
login.accountDisabled: AccioSoft has closed this account and it can no longer be signed in to. We e-mailed you the reason; if you disagree, you can complain by answering that message or from Help.

challenge.title: Confirm it is you
challenge.newDevice: This is the first time you sign in on this device. We have sent a 6-digit code to your e-mail: type it to get in. We will only ask this once.
challenge.newDeviceSending: This is the first time you sign in on this device. We are sending a code to your e-mail…
challenge.untrustedDevice: This is the first time you sign in on this device. Confirm it from another of your devices or with a code we send to your e-mail. We will only ask this once.
challenge.knownDevice: For your security, this device has to be confirmed again. We have e-mailed you a 6-digit code: type it to get in.
challenge.knownDeviceSending: For your security, this device has to be confirmed again. We are e-mailing you a code…
challenge.knownDeviceChoice: For your security, this device has to be confirmed again: from another of your devices, or with a code we e-mail you.
challenge.twoFactor: Your account has two-step verification turned on.
challenge.approvalIntro: Open AccioPass on one of your trusted devices and choose this number
challenge.denied: It was denied from another of your devices. If that was you by mistake, sign in again. If it was not you, someone knows your master password: change it as soon as you can.
challenge.expired: Too much time passed without confirming it. Sign in again to retry.
challenge.useTotp: Use a code from the authenticator app
challenge.emailIntro: We will send a 6-digit code to the e-mail of your account.
challenge.emailSent: We have sent you a 6-digit code. Enter it here.
challenge.emailResendIn: You can ask for another in {time}.
challenge.emailResent: We have sent you a new code.
challenge.totpIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for AccioPass.
challenge.recoveryIntro: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification. Each code works only once.
challenge.offline: Confirming the sign-in needs a connection.

unlock.title: Unlock your vault
unlock.wrongPassword: The master password is not correct. Type it again.
unlock.offline: Offline. You can still unlock: your vault is on this device.
unlock.sessionEndedTitle: Your session on the server has ended
unlock.sessionEnded: You can unlock and use your vault. To sync again you will need to sign in.
unlock.recovered: Master password changed. Unlock with the new one. The API keys of the account have been revoked.
unlock.linked: Account linked. Unlock to see it in Settings.

logout.title: Sign out on this device?
logout.message: To come back you will need the e-mail and the master password of the account.
logout.wipe: Also erase the data on this device
logout.wipeHint: Removes the encrypted copy of the vault kept here. Changes that have not synced yet will be lost. What is already synced stays in your account.
logout.keepHint: If you do not erase it, the encrypted copy stays on this device and only opens with the master password.

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.intro: You need the e-mail of the account and your 24 recovery words. At the end you will choose a new master password.
recover.emailSent: If there is an account for {email}, we have just sent it a 6-digit code. It expires in 15 minutes.
recover.wordsPlaceholder: Type or paste the 24 words here, in order
recover.wordsHint: Separated by spaces or line breaks. You can paste them all at once.
recover.wordsUnknown: Word no. {position} is not in the list. Show the words and check it for a typo.

wordsCountWrong.one: There must be 24 words and there is {count}.
wordsCountWrong.other: There must be 24 words and there are {count}.

recover.wordsChecksum: All 24 words exist, but together they are not a valid phrase. One of them is a similar word, or they are in a different order.
recover.wordsRejected: These words are not the ones for this account. Check that you are using the last ones you generated and that the e-mail is right. The code you had is no longer valid: ask for another one to try again.
recover.twoFactorHint: If it was turned on, we also ask for the current code from your authenticator app or, if you do not have it at hand, one of its recovery codes.
recover.twoFactorRequired: This account has two-step verification and needs a valid code from your authenticator app. The e-mailed code you had is no longer valid: ask for another one to try again.
recover.twoFactorUseRecoveryCode: I do not have the app: use a recovery code
recover.twoFactorUseApp: Use the code from the authenticator app
recover.twoFactorRecoveryHint: One of the ten codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification (not the 24 words). Each one works only once.
recover.twoFactorRecoveryRejected: That recovery code is not right or has already been used. The e-mailed code you had is no longer valid: ask for another one to try again.
recover.resendIn: You can ask for another code in {time}.
recover.resent: If the account exists, we have sent it a new code.
recover.passwordIntro: Choose the master password you will open your vault with from now on. You will be signed out on all your devices and every API key of the account will be revoked: if you used any, you will have to create it again.
recover.backToProof: Back to the code and the words
recover.done: Master password changed. Sign in with the new one. The API keys of the account have been revoked.
recover.offline: Recovering the account needs a connection.
recover.noWords: Without them there is no way to open the vault: nobody else holds the key. That is the other side of nobody else being able to read your data.

oauth.accountExistsTitle: You already have an account with this e-mail
oauth.signupIntro: {provider} has confirmed that you are {email}. To create your AccioPass account, the most important part is missing: the password that encrypts your vault.
oauth.signupWhy: Even when you sign in with {provider}, your vault only opens with the master password: {provider} does not know it and cannot replace it.
